summary: Independent R3 review found two P1 and two P2 contract defects: unfrozen screening inputs, ambiguous authorization-versus-consumption states, separable Gate values/provenance, and incomplete CCC numerical/checkpoint semantics.

limitations: Read-only review; no repository, ledger, Git, remote, training, budget, or final-OOS mutation.
The review does not authorize implementation or empirical M7 execution.

blockers: Freeze the screening prerequisite bundle before any candidate or fit event.
Bind Gate values and PIT provenance in one immutable verified object.
Freeze CCC numerical, early-stop, and checkpoint semantics.
